notes.title: Hard Drop Update - Centrist (V1.25)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=52VpTtRoU_g;full][/previewyoutube]

Hard drop has been feature that some people have been asking for, so here it is! Options page was running out of space so i decided to create separate pages for audio, controls and graphics options.

[list]
[*] Added hard drop (X on keyboard by default)
[*] Added separate option pages for controls, graphics and audio
[*] Moved language page to options menu
[*] Changed drop with mouse controls from soft drop to hard drop
[*] Changed default rotate button to C
[*] Changed default music volume to 50%
[*] Removed black background from options when viewing mouse controls
[/list]

notes.title: Particle Effect Update - Centrist (V1.19)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ptF-hnzQfYs;full][/previewyoutube]

New particle effects have been added to the game! Clearing layers should now feel even more satisfying.
Also since there has been lot of changes, i thought it would be about time to create new trailer.

[list]
[*] Added particle effects when clearing layers
[*] Added option for effects
[*] Added 6 new blocks and challenges
[/list]

notes.title: Block Update - Centrist(V1.12)

 I included some extra hard challenges that go beyond steam achievements.

notes.title: Extremist Update (v1.03)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added new game mode "Extremist"
[*] Added new special block "Flame" (exclusive for extremist mode)
[*] Added 3 new achievements
[*] There is now small delay before blocks can be moved sideways when playing with mouse controls (same as auto-shift delay)
[*] Fixed auto-shift timer not resetting after using bombs
[/list]
